purpose: re-evaluate frozen temporal outputs under the originally intended population, pooled 2D metric, and frozen pose-evaluation contract
reasons_for_closure: pilot population admitted evaluation-ineligible DEV_UNVERIFIED frames
2D aggregation was frame-summary-of-summary rather than pooled corners
6D path bypassed the frozen prediction-only pose selector

what_each_defect_was.population: TEMPORAL_METHOD_LOCK excludes 'FT_OVERLAP_or_evaluation_ineligible' as a pilot centre. The builder filtered only FT_OVERLAP, so DEV_UNVERIFIED frames were admitted. The lock's own wording was not followed.
what_each_defect_was.2D_aggregation: the pilot reported median of per-frame medians and median of per-frame p90s. A p90 of per-frame p90s is not the p90 of the corner error distribution, and frames with few corners carried the same weight as frames with many.
what_each_defect_was.6D_path: the pilot solved both width/depth hypotheses itself and kept the smaller reprojection residual. The repository already has predict_pose_without_gt, which routes through the frozen select_pnp_hypotheses. Substituting a private selector makes the numbers incomparable with every other pose result in this repository.
what_each_defect_was.coverage_threshold: ACCEPTABLE was declared at coverage >= 0.90, a number chosen while writing the evaluator rather than before the measurement.

this_closure_is_not_an_algorithm_experim: no threshold is being selected here, so the lock-before-result separation is procedural bookkeeping rather than evidence for a paper claim, and it is not presented as such

evaluation_contract_to_be_used.object_contract: data/pallet/results/paper_pose_metric_closure_v1/POSE_EVAL_OBJECT_CONTRACT.json, loaded and hashed, dimensions never hardcoded
evaluation_contract_to_be_used.pose_reference: existing geometry-reconstructed reference where the centre appears in it; otherwise POSE_REFERENCE_UNAVAILABLE, never a newly built one
evaluation_contract_to_be_used.2D: pooled supervised corner errors across frames, with the total corner count reported
evaluation_contract_to_be_used.6D_metrics: existing definitions only — rotation, yaw, translation medians, exact oriented IoU3D, symmetry-aware ADD AUC over the frozen [0, 0.1 x diameter] range
evaluation_contract_to_be_used.coverage: reported as a number, with no qualitative threshold

known_broken_rule: only sets recorded as broken before the temporal work may be excluded on that basis, such as pallet11_gt APRILTAG_BROKEN. Recordings may not be dropped because their error turned out large.
population_limited_rule: if the formal eligible count is zero or too small to evaluate, report FORMAL_TEMPORAL_PILOT = POPULATION_LIMITED and classify the original 109-centre run as EXPLORATORY_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY. Relaxing the eligibility rule to manufacture a usable N is forbidden.
original_pilot_is_preserved: TEMPORAL_PILOT_EVALUATION.json and its report are not edited or deleted; the closure report cites them in a separate exploratory section
